before: Suggesting mode applied a local edit with no tracked form, such as a page-setup change, directly and without a suggestion.
after: With reviewModule({ untrackedEdits: 'refuse' }), suggesting mode refuses such a local edit before it commits, so nothing is journaled or sent. The default 'apply' keeps the previous behavior.
reason: Only local command handling changes. Remote operations, undo and redo, shared nodes, text offsets, operations, and package serialization remain unchanged.
